say:1:1441102001:1.text: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
say:1:1441102001:1.source_cn: 主人，满满觉得这里的矮人对魔法师的态度好奇怪！
say:1:1441102001:1.male: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
say:1:1441102001:1.female: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?

choice_prompt:2:1441102001.text: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
choice_prompt:2:1441102001.source_cn: 主人，满满觉得这里的矮人对魔法师的态度好奇怪！
choice_prompt:2:1441102001.male: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?
choice_prompt:2:1441102001.female: Magister, isn't it strange how the dwarves here treat mages?

say:3:1441102002:1.text: Remember Hugin when he first met us? He was thrilled to find out you were a mage!
say:3:1441102002:1.source_cn: 呼金认识我们的时候，听到主人是魔法师可是很高兴的。
say:3:1441102002:1.male: Remember Hugin when he first met us? He was thrilled to find out you were a mage!
say:3:1441102002:1.female: Remember Hugin when he first met us? He was thrilled to find out you were a mage!

say:4:1441102003:1.text: But the chief here... He seems happy to have us around, but I can sense that he feels otherwise deep down.
say:4:1441102003:1.source_cn: 可是这个村长……虽然表面很热情，心里却好像不这么想。

say:5:1441102004:1.text: The craftsmen are all busy working... It's as if they're deliberately keeping their distance from us.
say:5:1441102004:1.source_cn: 矮人工匠们也都忙着在生产线干活，像是刻意和我们保持距离。

say:6:1441102005:1.text: Chippy thought we'd be welcomed with open arms here!
say:6:1441102005:1.source_cn: 满满还以为，我们在村里会很受欢迎！

say:7:1441102006:1.text: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!
say:7:1441102006:1.source_cn: 会有很多矮人想让主人帮他们锻造的武器附魔！
say:7:1441102006:1.male: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!
say:7:1441102006:1.female: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!

choice_prompt:8:1441102006.text: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!
choice_prompt:8:1441102006.source_cn: 会有很多矮人想让主人帮他们锻造的武器附魔！
choice_prompt:8:1441102006.male: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!
choice_prompt:8:1441102006.female: And the dwarves would be pestering Magister to enchant their weapons!

say:10:1441102007:1.text: Hey, Magister isn't someone they can order around!
say:10:1441102007:1.source_cn: 主人可不是他们能随意差遣的！
say:10:1441102007:1.male: Hey, Magister isn't someone they can order around!
say:10:1441102007:1.female: Hey, Magister isn't someone they can order around!

say:12:1441102008:1.text: Let's think about the weapon production line we saw...
say:12:1441102008:1.source_cn: 不过，是不是因为我们看到的武器生产线……

say:13:1441102009:1.text: Seems like the dwarves are thriving without magic. Is that why they no longer feel the need for it?
say:13:1441102009:1.source_cn: 矮人们不靠魔法也能锻造出优质的成品，这让他们不再渴望魔...

say:14:1441102010:1.text: Anyway, Magister is more than happy to work with friendly dwarves like Hugin.
say:14:1441102010:1.source_cn: 主人是很欢迎和呼金这样友善的矮人进行魔法合作的。
say:14:1441102010:1.male: Anyway, Magister is more than happy to work with friendly dwarves like Hugin.
say:14:1441102010:1.female: Anyway, Magister is more than happy to work with friendly dwarves like Hugin.

say:15:1441102011:1.text: As long as they don't desire the power of magic while looking down on mages!
say:15:1441102011:1.source_cn: 只希望他们不要既贪婪魔法的力量，又看不起魔法师！
